name: caveman
description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Shortens prose while preserving technical terms, code, commands, and exact errors.

hooks.command: HOOK_ROOT=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}; case "$HOOK_ROOT" in /[A-Za-z]/*) HOOK_ROOT="${HOOK_ROOT#/}"; HOOK_ROOT="${HOOK_ROOT%%/*}:/${HOOK_ROOT#*/}" ;; *) HOOK_ROOT="$HOOK_ROOT" ;; esac; node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/caveman-activate.js"

HOOK_ROOT=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}; case "$HOOK_ROOT" in /[A-Za-z]/*) HOOK_ROOT="${HOOK_ROOT#/}"; HOOK_ROOT="${HOOK_ROOT%%/*}:/${HOOK_ROOT#*/}" ;; *) HOOK_ROOT="$HOOK_ROOT" ;; esac; node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/caveman-mode-tracker.js"
